title.en: Thorough cleaning with occasional choppy finishes

text.en: Pet owners report pleasing washing, de-shedding, and breed haircuts on large dogs such as Bernese Mountain Dogs, leaving coats clean and fresh. In contrast, one client complained of an uneven, choppy trim around their dog ear area after specific online instructions were allegedly overlooked by the groomer.

Several clients praise individual stylists such as Amber and Dallas for their swift, accommodating approach during grooming appointments. However, another pet parent expressed irritation over poor communication, noting that the stylist dismissed haircut instructions as customer miscommunication.

title.en: Attentive grooming care with mixed patient feedback

text.en: Reviewers note that groomers handle large breeds and family dogs with patience during standard washing and grooming appointments. Nonetheless, one dissatisfied pet owner felt that their dog received hasty handling when attempting to correct an incomplete trim, warning of inconsistent animal attention.

q.en: Can online booking notes be accommodated during check-in?

a.en: Yes, clients can add styling requests when booking online, though owners recommend confirming haircut details directly with staff at drop-off.

q.en: Are large dog breeds accepted for grooming?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention full wash and groom appointments for large breeds including Bernese Mountain Dogs.

q.en: How prompt is the grooming turnaround?

a.en: Clients observe that individual groomers like Amber provide quick turnaround times while ensuring pets are thoroughly washed and dried.

q.en: Are revision trims provided if a haircut needs adjustments?

a.en: Groomers can perform touch-up clipping upon collection, although experiences differ on how smoothly adjustments are handled.
